<span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>Seventh Stratagem</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>无中生有</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(wú
zhōng shēng yǒu)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Create
Something out of Nothing</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">i.e.
Make an opponent believe there is something when in fact there is
nothing.</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">In
383 A.D., during the Battle of Fei River, the Former Qin had an
overwhelming advantage, in numbers, over Jin. Instead of contracting
into a defensive, Jin attacked the Qin forces early on, making wide
formations, and giving the illusion that they indeed had the manpower
to match the Qin forces. Emperor Fu Jian (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">苻坚</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">,
337-385 A.D.) of Former Qin was forced to begin his planning under
pressure, and eventually ordered almost all of his forces to retreat
from the river banks. Low morale caused the Former Qin to go into
chaos, and Jin came out victorious [20].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Create
Something out of Nothing</span></i></span> is associated both with
the second hexagram, <i>Earth over Earth</i>, and the 24th hexagram,
<i>Earth over Thunder</i>. Earth over Earth represents the tenth
lunar month, when Yin is at its fullest, expressing itself in snow
and frost. After the winter solstice, Yang begins to rise again, this
being represented by Earth over Thunder. i.e. We move from the still
and silent winter into the teeming and stirring. Similarly, from the
seemingly empty can be drawn a hidden power [1], [28].</span></p>

<img style="display: block; margin-right: auto; margin-left: 0;" alt="" src="data:image/png;base64," /></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span>


	
	
	
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="font-size: x-large;"><b><span style="color: #333333;">Sample Sentences 7:</span></b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section57" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们不要听你们吵架。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: We don’t want to
	listen to you fight.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你们为什么在争辩？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Why are you (pl.)
	arguing?</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他喝酒的时候喜欢打架。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她不吃肉因为她觉得杀生不好。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你能不能带一些箱子来我家？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们下一次见面的时候</span></span>,<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们的小孩可以</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;一起玩。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我很累</span></span>,<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我要睡觉。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我在哪里可以洗手？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在洗手间。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">9)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这里太热了</span></span>,<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你应该把外套脱下来。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">10)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的中文说得很好，但是我的中文写的</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;不太好。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">11)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你有没有见过我的哥哥小龙？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">没有，我没有见过他。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">12)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你在学怎么说汉语吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">   
	   &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">是的，不太容易。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">13)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你在学怎么写汉字吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">是的，</span></span><span style="font-family: times;"><span lang="zh-CN">我在学</span></span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">1</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">4)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">她喜欢无糖的食物</span>。</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
    <span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /><br />15) </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">他的狗生了一只小狗。</span></span><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">16)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你能不能用中文聊天？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">   
	   &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">简单的可以。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">17)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你为什么不用英文说话？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">18)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们上一次见面的时候，喝茶、抽烟、</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;聊聊天，很愉快。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">19)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你在做什么？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我在看书。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">20)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你能不能读这个句子？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">21)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个洗手间不太干净，没有人打扫吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">22)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你要不要和我们一起去海边游泳？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不要，我的头疼。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">23)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他告诉我在这里修理东西是免费的。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">2</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">4)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: times; font-size: large;"> </span><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-family: times; font-size: large;">她在玩中学。</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">25)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我去我妹妹那里取一本书，但是她没有</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;给我。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">26)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我要把外套脱下来，这个房间变得太热</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">27)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">当他十八岁的时候，他买了第一辆车。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">28)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">十年以后</span></span>,
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他变成了一个老师。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	29)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他很难过，因为他的狗死了。</span></span></span></p>
</div>
<br><br><br>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-6-make-feint.html">Previous Chapter</a>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-8-openly.html">Next Chapter</a><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-8-openly.html"></a>

</p>
